description: D1 /query corrections. (1) `d1_params` items accept any JSON scalar, not only strings: foundation_db binds integers, reals and NULL as JSON numbers and null. (2) `d1_query_meta` `changes` and `rows_written` are integers: they are SQLite row counts.
source: (1) The vendored spec types d1_params as an array of string. The local wrangler worker (worker-stub.js) binds JSON numbers and null through the D1 binding (verified with local wrangler 4.156.2, 2026-11-03: `typeof()` reads back integer, real, null and text for 7, 1.5, null and the text x, see foundation_db tests/d1_param_types_wrangler.rs). Local wrangler runs the D1 binding, not Cloudflare's hosted REST front end, so that is the check the owner accepted; no hosted-account test exists. (2) D1 responses carry whole numbers for these two counters; the spec's `number` is looser than the wire.

items.description: One bound value: a JSON string, number, boolean or null.
